# cohort-isp-01 source-surface WRITE SITE baseline — magnitude only.
#
# Format: `<count> <family>|<path>`, plus one `TOTAL <n>` line.
# Generated by
# `python -m scripts.architecture.isp_cohort_writers --baseline sites`.
#
# Two-directional, and compared only for files present on BOTH sides:
# membership is the file baseline's job, so a failure here always
# means an existing writer grew or shrank rather than appeared.
#
# TOTAL is exact. It catches the one case per-file counts cannot: a
# write moved between files nets to zero per file only if both sides
# were already baselined, and the total proves the aggregate did not
# drift while the per-file diff looked innocent.
#
# 2026-08-22 — `service|app/services/gis_sync.py` ADDED deliberately. It is
# not a new parallel writer: `gis.spatial_sync` is the declared owner of an
# address coordinate and its map projection, and this is the first release in
# which it actually performs that write instead of leaving it to callers.
# `customer_location_requests` fell 6 sites to 1 in the same change and the
# total fell 101 -> 99, so the surface shrank while ownership concentrated.
# The census is authority-blind by design; it counts files, not owners.
#
# 2026-09-11 — the typed `customer.canonical_profile_patch` participant adds
# 20 explicit Customer/profile write sites and `party.registry` adds two
# explicit canonical Party synchronization sites. These are the registered
# owners used by Inbox completion, not parallel adapter writers.
#
# 2026-10-03 — the registered `customer.portal_profile_commands` owner adds
# two direct Subscriber writes: email verification reset and the declared
# notification preference projection. Profile values are saved in its one
# owner-managed transaction; the portal adapter has no parallel writer.
#
# 2026-10-10 — migration 664 adds one write site: the single UPDATE that
# removes retired Splynx keys from `subscribers.metadata` (contract step, no
# new fact). Total 122 -> 123.
#
# 2026-10-10 — migration 665 adds two write sites: the billing-contact INSERT
# (the typed home for `splynx_billing_email`) and the UPDATE that removes the
# moved key from `subscribers.metadata`. Total 123 -> 125.

#
# 2026-10-11 — `customer.registration_metadata` is the registered flush-only
# participant restricted to `auth.credential_administration`. Existing optional-
# login form fields (subscriber_number, category, notes) previously passed via
# SubscriberUpdate to the generic Subscribers.update loop. Four explicit ORM
# assignments (number, two category branches, notes) are newly counted; the
# generic owner remains for its other consumers. This is existing behavior
# moved into the atomic metadata/login/audit/outbox coordinator, not four new
# facts. Census 125 -> 129; cutover disposition RETIRE_AFTER_CUTOVER.
#
# 2026-10-11 â€” migration 671 adds one downgrade-only write site that clears
# connection-type values outside the former closed vocabulary before restoring
# its check constraint. Alembic owns this one-time schema lineage operation;
# it does not add a runtime writer. Census 129 -> 130.
#

# 2026-10-12 — count tracked Session.delete(instance) writes as well. The
# accepted tree had three previously uncounted subscriber.py deletions (133
# total with this detector). Retiring two parent writers and adding the typed
# deletion coordinator reduces that corrected census to 132. The remaining
# address deletion is existing debt; no runtime write behavior was added.
